# pve_storage_scan_pbs (Data Source)

Proxmox Backup Server instances discovered by scanning from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_pbs" "example" {
  node     = "pve1"
  password = "CHANGE_ME"
  server   = "CHANGE_ME"
  username = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password or API token secret.
- `server` (String) The server address (name or IP).
- `username` (String) User-name or API token-ID.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `port` (Number) Optional port. (default: 8007)

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/pbs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment from server.
- `store` (String) The datastore name.
